title: Two pairs share a message id (or a request id), then a record with only that id
policy: P4 and P5: two pairs sharing one id are two operations. A record with only the shared id can't be joined to either without risking merging them, so it is counted on its own and marked ambiguous; its own growth is still counted once.
derivation: (msg_27, req_27a) [100, 50] and (msg_27, req_27b) [200, 20]: two identified operations, 370. msg_27 alone [100, 60] then [100, 70]: one ambiguous operation [100, 70], 170. (msg_27c, req_27q) [10, 5] and (msg_27d, req_27q) [10, 5]: two identified, 30. req_27q alone [10, 6]: ambiguous, 16. Input 100+200+100+10+10+10 = 430, output 50+20+70+5+5+6 = 156, 6 operations, 586.
